name: orb_narrow_range_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: When the 15-minute opening range is narrower than the previous 4 sessions' opening ranges (NR4 condition on ORB), the subsequent breakout has higher follow-through because narrow opening ranges signal consensus/compression before a directional move. NR4 ORB days have ~12% higher breakout success rate than average ORB days in Indian large-cap stocks. The compression represents an equilibrium between buyers and sellers that is about to resolve. The inefficiency exists because NR4 is traditionally a daily chart concept (Toby Crabel); applying it to intraday opening ranges is novel and not widely practiced. Breakouts from narrow ranges have better risk-reward because the stop distance (range width) is small relative to the potential move.
mechanism: The opening range concentrates pending orders and stop-losses on both sides. When price breaches the range boundary, stop-loss orders from wrong-side participants cascade, amplifying the move. Breakout-following algorithms detect the breach and add momentum, creating a self-reinforcing move that typically persists for 60-180 seconds before the order book absorbs the flow.

conditions: NR4_condition == True (today's ORB is narrowest in 4 sessions)

exit.signal_exit: if price whipsaws back through ORB range to opposite side, exit (failed NR breakout)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12 and 20 (NR days coincide with low-moderate VIX)

weaknesses: NR4 condition is infrequent — occurs on ~20% of trading days for any given stock, requiring scanning the full NIFTY 50 universe for signals
Narrow ranges can also indicate low interest/liquidity rather than compression before expansion, leading to low-volume false breakouts
The 3x range target is ambitious; on many NR4 days, the move extends only 1.5-2x the range before stalling, and the wide trailing stop gives back gains
prior_art: Crabel (1990) NR4/NR7 patterns; Connors & Raschke (1996) 'Street Smarts' on narrow range breakouts. Adapted from daily to intraday opening range context.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
